title: US to Blacklist AI Firm Megaspeed
excerpt: Megaspeed faces US blacklisting over allegations that it funneled AI chips to China following a scandal involving a former executive.
body_html:
The United States is planning to place Asian artificial intelligence company Megaspeed on a blacklist. The upcoming restriction follows accusations that the firm directed AI chips toward China.

The allegations against Megaspeed came to light after the personal relationship between a former executive of the company and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang became public knowledge. Following the disclosure, scrutiny increased around the company's activities and the movement of advanced technology.

Megaspeed has not yet addressed the blacklisting plans publicly. The situation highlights ongoing concerns regarding the unauthorized transfer of sensitive technology and AI chips to restricted regions.
